meta.title: Swarm
meta.description: Send /swarm-mode in a conversation to enable collaboration and open the panel. The lead delegates to named teammates. They share a workspace and DSH stores their posts. Parallel work incurs model calls. Disabling the plugin unloads the command, tools, and panel.

ui.subtitle: Board, members, and collaboration graph
ui.notSwarm: This session is not a swarm
ui.notSwarmHint: Enter /swarm-mode in this conversation to activate its board.
ui.notLiveHint: The lead session is not loaded. Members come from storage and models cannot be changed yet.
ui.followHint: Keep the newest post in view
ui.emptyBoardHint: Briefs and messages between members appear here once the lead spawns teammates.
ui.composerPlaceholder: Post as Me, Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line
ui.removeHint: Remove this member permanently; it cannot be restored
ui.memberNotLive: This member is not loaded, so its model cannot change. Open its conversation and try again.
ui.graphHint: Arrows point from the poster to each addressed member. Thicker lines mean more posts.
